resources.string: Visible status and cancellation for an approved same-phone browser transfer.
Same-phone browser only. The one-use code expires after five minutes.
Preview received. Review and save in your account, or cancel here.
Reviewed metadata reached the browser. Account-save acknowledgment remains available for up to two hours; save or decline each source there, or cancel if you are using browser-only review.
The one-use pairing code has been consumed. Nothing is saved to an account by delivery alone. Confirm each browser source save before ending this handoff.
The browser acknowledged confirmed account saves. The local handoff is closed.
